class.name: RecyclerViewScrollBar
class.brief_description: Protocol base for a RecyclerView scroll bar (a child Control).
class.description:
RecyclerViewScrollBar is the protocol for scroll bars: a Control that the RecyclerView binds as a child and pins to the trailing edge. The RecyclerView calls [method on_scroll_changed] on every scroll / layout and exposes [method get_offset], [method get_viewport_size] and [method get_content_size]. Subclass it to draw your own bar in [code]_draw[/code] and handle dragging in [code]_gui_input[/code]; override [method _on_scroll_changed] to refresh the appearance. The built-in implementation is [b]DefaultScrollBar[/b].
Attach via [method RecyclerView.set_scroll_bar]; the axis is chosen automatically from the layout direction.

method.name: _on_scroll_changed
method.description: Optional virtual called on every scroll / layout; override to refresh a custom bar. When overridden the base class does not redraw automatically: call [code]queue_redraw()[/code] yourself (or draw in [code]_draw[/code] and queue it here).

method.name: bind_to
method.description: Called by [method RecyclerView.set_scroll_bar]: records the RecyclerView, selects the axis from the layout direction and pins the Control to the trailing edge.

method.name: get_content_size
method.description: Returns the content size along the axis.

method.name: get_viewport_size
method.description: Returns the viewport size along the axis.

method.name: on_scroll_changed
method.description: Called by the RecyclerView on every scroll / layout. The base tries the [method _on_scroll_changed] virtual first, then falls back to [code]queue_redraw()[/code].

method.name: set_auto_hide
method.description: Sets whether the bar fades out when the list is idle (base class stores the value; DefaultScrollBar implements it).

method.name: set_axis
method.description: Sets the scroll axis: [constant SCROLL_BAR_VERTICAL] or [constant SCROLL_BAR_HORIZONTAL].

method.name: set_hide_delay
method.description: Sets the seconds before the bar fades out after the last activity (default 0.5).

method.name: set_recycler_view
method.description: Records the RecyclerView this bar is bound to.

method.name: set_thickness
method.description: Sets the bar thickness in pixels (default 8).
